group.label: Google Analytics
group.comment: GA4 e-commerce events on the Zero storefront: item lists, product views, cart, checkout steps, purchase, search, sign in and sign up. Magento's own Google Analytics/Gtag modules use RequireJS and send nothing on Zero pages; turn them off if you use this one.

field.label: Send With
field.comment: GA4 directly: gtag.js with your Measurement ID. Google Tag Manager: the same events go to the dataLayer in GA4 e-commerce format; your container decides where they go (GA4, Ads, others).

field.label: GA4 Measurement ID
field.comment: G-XXXXXXXXXX. Empty: the one in Sales > Google API > Google Analytics (Magento's own setting) is used.

field.label: GTM Container ID
field.comment: GTM-XXXXXXX. Tags in the container that load other hosts (or Custom HTML) need those hosts in the store's CSP.

field.label: Debug Mode
field.comment: Events show in GA4's DebugView and are logged in the browser console. Turn off on a live store.

group.label: Consent (Google Consent Mode v2)
group.comment: Google's analytics and advertising storage follow the visitor's choice of cookies (Zero > Cookie Consent: the banner, Global Privacy Control, Do Not Sell or Share). Google requires Consent Mode v2 for visitors from the EEA and the UK.

field.label: Before Consent
field.comment: Advanced: Google's tag loads at once and sends cookieless pings until consent (GA4 models the rest). Basic: nothing from Google loads until the visitor accepts.
